snippet.title: Mechjestic Demo Version Trailer - OUT NOW ON STEAM! ⚙
snippet.description:
YOUR time has finally come!💪

Build the DECK🃏 - Craft your MECH!🤖

Mechjestic is a singeplayer, steampunk inspired, (F)roguelike Deck Builder RPG🐸. With more than 28+ Million Mech combinations available, combined with our unique Refuel mechanic, this Deckbuilder gives players a lot of freedom to play their cards how they see fit and make every turn count. There is never one way to finish a fight, and Mechjestic gives players the option to find their favorite strategies!

Mechjestic Demo Version gives you a glimpse of the many possibilites the game will have to offer. What strategies will you implement to overcome the evil Timeless Machines? Complete the Tutorial and battle your way through the Beginner Overworld. Gear up with your rewarded cards and face the menacing inventor; Dr. Chronos! 

Beginner mode to easy? After completing the mode for the first time, you will unlock Challenge mode! Put all your knowledge and skills to the test to reach the final obstacle called; Jawlock!

Mechjestic's Music is composed by the great : Yasunori Shiono 🎶

⚙ Visual Mech Building 🦾
⚙ Refuel Mechanic 🔥
⚙ Dedicated Engine ⚡
⚙ Overworld Puzzle Mechanics 💎

Mechjestic - Demo Version is Out Now on Steam!
